credits.title: Snoopy Unleashed

credits.overview: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
credits.overview: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: A Summer Musical
credits.overview: Music and glee fill the air as Charlie Brown and the gang head off to summer camp. First-timer Sally doesn't get what all the hype is about. But when the camp may be forced to close, they team up to save it so more kids can make their own special memories.

credits.title: Night of the Zoopocalypse
credits.overview: A wolf and mountain lion team up when a meteor unleashes a virus turning zoo animals into zombies. They join forces with other survivors to rescue the zoo and stop the deranged mutant leader from spreading the virus.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: Welcome Home, Franklin
credits.overview: Franklin is new to town and hoping to make friends, but his usual tactics don't work on the Peanuts gang. When the Soap Box Derby arrives, he's sure it's a chance to impress new pals and teams up with the only other unpartnered kid: Charlie Brown.

credits.title: My Little Pony: Secrets of Starlight
credits.overview: After defeating Opaline, the mane 6 uncover a portal to another realm, inhabited by aurora-corns. Sunny and her friends notice something strange is going on in Starlight Ridge, a dictating winged snow leopard is reigning supreme and the mane 6 take it upon themselves to stop her.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: One-of-a-Kind Marcie
credits.overview: Quiet, kindhearted introvert Marcie has lots of brilliant ideas to help her friends achieve goals and solve problems. But when the world takes notice and the spotlight lands on her, sharing those ideas becomes a challenge.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: Lucy's School
credits.overview: The Peanuts gang is anxious about starting at a new school in the fall, inspiring Lucy to start her own school instead. She soon learns that teaching isn't as easy as it sounds and that change can be a good thing.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: To Mom (and Dad), with Love
credits.overview: Mother's Day is almost here, and the gang is excited—except Peppermint Patty. For her, it's a reminder that she didn’t grow up with a mom. But good pal Marcie helps Peppermint Patty see that families come in all shapes and sizes.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: For Auld Lang Syne
credits.overview: After finding out her grandmother won't be visiting for Christmas, Lucy decides to cheer herself up by throwing the ultimate New Year's Eve party. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown tries to fulfill one of his resolutions before the clock strikes midnight.
